title: Taliban Forces Surround Office of Afghanistan's Shia High Council in Kabul's Karte Char
detail: Taliban forces surrounded the office of Afghanistan's High Shia Council — a body established in coordination with the Taliban and reportedly backed by its intelligence apparatus — in the Karte Char area of Kabul at around 2 p.m. on Tuesday, September 8, 2026. The Taliban did not publicly disclose a reason for the operation. The move extends a week-long crackdown on Shia institutions in Kabul: Taliban forces first surrounded the Khatam al-Nabieen seminary and ordered its evacuation on September 5, detained three prominent Shia leaders — Sufi Gardizi, Sayed Hassan Sharifi Balkhabi and Mohammad Hossein Sangardoost — on September 6, then forcibly evicted seminary students and detained 28 more (24 remain held) on September 7. The Taliban government has not commented on the Karte Char operation.

title: Pakistan Kills Afghan National Ubaidullah Saad, Fitna al-Khawarij Commander, in Kurram District Operation
detail: Pakistani security forces killed four Fitna al-Khawarij (TTP) militants, including Afghan national Ubaidullah Saad, in an intelligence-based operation in Kurram district, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, on September 8, 2026. ISPR identified Saad as the son of Ghulam Ghaus Salehi, a resident of Shah Qila village in Afghanistan's Logar province, and described him as a key militant commander involved in multiple terrorist activities inside Pakistan. The military said security forces would continue operations 'without discrimination against anti-state elements infiltrating Pakistan from Afghanistan' and reiterated that repeated cross-border incidents showed Afghan Taliban authorities had failed to prevent their territory from being used for militant activity.
